title: Thread-Safe Lending Service with Domain Errors
instructions: Implement `LendingService` in `lending.py` (the exception classes and the frozen `Loan` are provided). Lending must be atomic under one `threading.Lock`, use distinct `LibraryError` subclasses for each rule, validate in the order unknown ISBN, no copies, member limit, and take due dates from the injected `clock`. A failed call must change no state.

evidence.label: lend returns a frozen Loan due 14 days after the injected clock
Unknown ISBNs and exhausted copies raise the right errors
The borrow limit is enforced per member
Checks run in the documented order
Returns restore the copy and strangers are rejected
All business errors share the LibraryError base class
max_loans is validated and the input mapping is copied
Concurrent lending never oversells or exceeds the member limit
